'''Lil. Ling''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Lil. Ling:''' Hmm... Mr. [[Baisong|Bosong]] always tells me to play with everyone more.
:'''Lil. Ling:''' But I really like to play with Ms. Yuyi...
:'''Lil. Ling:''' But I haven't seen Ms. Yuyi for a long time. I wonder how she's doing... Ms. Yuyi is a very good teacher.
:'''Lil. Ling:''' But- but Mr. Bosong is also very kind! Alright, I guess I can join [[Xinxin]] and her friends next time if it can keep Mr. Bosong from worrying.
----
;(During the evening)
:'''Lil. Ling:''' Mr. Bosong, you look unhappy.
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong?
:'''Lil. Ling:''' Look, Mr. Bosong is over there. He always alone at night.
:'''Lil. Ling:''' Though I'm used to this solitude, it feels different now.
:'''Lil. Ling:''' Did we make him angry? But recently, Ling'er has been a good girl. Or is it because Ms. Yuyi hasn't come back yet?
:'''Lil. Ling:''' But Mr. Bosong said that Ms. Yuyi had gone on an official trip.
:'''Lil. Ling:''' Then Ms. Yuyi will come back in a while, right? Why is Mr. Bosong still sad?
:'''Lil. Ling:''' Is the reason why Mr. Bosong is sad because Mr. Bosong is actually afraid of being alone? I see it now!
:'''Lil. Ling:''' Ms. Yuyi, Ms. Yuyi, please come back soon, so Mr. Bosong won't be sad when he's alone.
{{Dialogue End}}
